fact: The report says the national open data portal opendata.go.tz, launched in September 2015 and managed by the eGovernment Agency, held 163 datasets (755 resources) from 11 institutions in 4 sectors by June 2017, double the year before, under the Chief Secretary's January 2015 circular as the interim directive.

The National Bureau of Statistics and the Office of the Chief Government Statistician run the Tanzania Integrated Statistical Portal, which lets users explore and analyse administrative, demographic and survey data; no dataset count or open licence is stated, and the date is the document's publication date.

The Public Procurement Regulatory Authority publishes procurement data from procuring entities through the NeST Open Contracting Data Portal (data.nest.go.tz), updated daily with bulk JSON, CSV and Excel downloads updated weekly; the date is the policy's 2025 copyright year.

The Tanzania Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative states it has been disclosing data in open format through summary data sheets and its online data dashboard at teiti.go.tz/dashboard; downloadable openly licensed datasets are described as a future commitment.
